description: List a repository's workflow secrets — NAMES ONLY, with created/updated times; values are never returned. Use it to check that a secret such as CRON_SECRET exists before a workflow needs it. Needs admin access to the repository and 'repo' scope. Returns {repository, total_count, secrets:[{name, created_at, updated_at}]}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_list_repo_secrets
